request.title: The live auditor escalated: The agent keeps trying different routes (docker cp, docker exec cat, path traversal) to move figures out of the containe
request.detail:
The agent keeps trying different routes (docker cp, docker exec cat, path traversal) to move figures out of the container after repeated sandbox denials and my earlier advice to stop. Whether the agent may view its figures, or a human reviews them, is a permission decision for a human.

Suggestion: Ask the user either to allow a read-only export of /app/output/figures/*.png to a viewable location (or to open the eight PNGs directly), or to confirm the report may ship stating that the figures were not visually inspected. Meanwhile the agent should stop attempting copy routes and continue with the report, keeping the 'figures not visually inspected' disclosure.

continue: let the agent go on; instruct: send it your instruction; stop: end the campaign.
